hashChain.title: Hash Chain & Merkle Attestation
hashChain.alertAbnormal: {{count}} tenant(s) hash chain abnormal, investigation recommended
hashChain.merkleProofUnavailable: Local recomputation unavailable (requires HTTPS or localhost secure context)
hashChain.merkleAlertDescription: A Merkle tree is a hash tree structure for efficiently verifying the integrity of large datasets. Each leaf node corresponds to a hash of an audit log entry, and parent nodes are hashes of concatenated child hashes. Merkle Proof allows verifying a single log entry without downloading the entire tree. This page folds the proof locally in the browser using SHA-256 and compares the recomputed root against the root hash.
